entries.artha_hindi: cAro ora se nAcanA, cakkara lagAte hue nAcanA

examples: 'klIbA iva pranftyanto vane ye kurvate Gozam' (aTarva॰8.6.11). pranftyanto nartanapUrvakaM gacCantaH.
'pranftyatIva saNgrAme cApahasto DanaYjayaH' (BA॰vi॰62.9). harzAvizwaH pranfttavAn (=nartitumArabDa). praSabda AdikarmaRi.
'ye tadAsmAn pranftyanti punargOriti gOriti' (BA॰8.83.43). avahelayanto nartakavfttimAsTuH.
'yadIme keSino janA gfhe te samanartizuH' (aTarva॰14.2.59). samaM nftyamakArzurityarTaH.
'taM tamiti ninfttiH. antastftIyamaharnIva vA antaM gatvA ninftyati' (SAM0 brA0 20.4). ninfttirAvfttiH. ninftyati Avartate.
'tadyaTA'ByAgAramaBininartaM punaH punaH pApmAnaM nirhaRyAdevamevEtErasurAn nirGnanti' (SAM0 brA0 17.8).
'ye'smAnpuropanftyanta mUQA gOriti goriti. tAn vayaM pratinftyAmaH punargOriti gOriti' (BA0 Salya0 59.7)..
'ye SAlAH parinftyanti sAyaM gardaBanAdinaH' (aTarva0 8.6.10). parinftyanti parito nftyanti. upasargavaSAnnftiriha sakarmakaH.
'ye smAnpuropanftyanta mUQA gO rgOriti' (BA0 Salya0 59.7). ukto'rTaH.
'upagItopanfttaSca ganDarvApsarasAM gaROH' (BA0 u0 123.4). pratyaye viSezo nArTe.
'kzetraM hi rasavacCudDaM karmaREvopapAditam. fte varzAnna kOnteya jAtu nirvartayet Palam' (BA0).. upapAditaM sampAditaM sADitaM kftam. karmaRA karzaRena vApyAdijaladAnena ca.
